## Outcome
What observable result does this change deliver?

## Non-goals
What intentionally remains unchanged?

## Scope
Which files and boundaries changed?

## Verification evidence
Paste exact commands, exit results, and relevant artifacts.

## Risk and rollback
What can fail, and how is the change reversed?

## Checklist
- [ ] Issue satisfies Definition of Ready
- [ ] Tests cover behavior and repaired defects
- [ ] `make verify` passes
- [ ] Documentation and ADRs are updated
- [ ] Final diff contains no unrelated changes
- [ ] Definition of Done is satisfied
